newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Bancorp says officer to retire.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Bancorp says officer to retire.

text.p: U.S. Bancorp said on Friday President and Chief Operating Daniel Nelson has decided to take early retirement as of December 31.
Nelson had been slated to succeed Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Gerry Cameron upon his planned retirment in January 1999.

"In 1999...I will be close to 62 years-old and would have only a short time to lead the company. I think the next leader needs a longer span of time in which to leave a lasting mark," Nelson said in a statement.
A successor to Nelson was not named.
Nelson, 59, said he will spend more time with his family. He has 34 years experience in the banking industry. For 10 years, he was chief executive officer of West One Bancorp.
